integrity: Original complete odd-parameter proof; finite Apéry and gcd tests are reproducibility checks, not substitutes for infinite proof; no assertion of independent validation or authorship.
scientific_limitations: Proves symmetry, complete-intersection and cyclotomic classifications only for odd polygonal side counts >=3, starting indices >=2. The Frobenius and genus formulas apply only to symmetric instances. General structural gluing and cyclotomic equivalence come from prior literature; independent priority and mathematical audit are outstanding. Literature on even-sided generalized-star triples is out of the stated domain.
title: Symmetric semigroups of three consecutive centered odd-gonal numbers
